newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux seeks world media role.
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux seeks world media role.

text.p: French Compagnie Generale des Eaux, which is in talks with Havas about their media stakes and notably that of cable TV firm Canal Plus, wants to become a communications group on a scale to compete with world players, chairman Jean-Marie Messier said on Wednesday.

"What we're trying to do is create a French group capable of competing with its world rivals...and which will be lasting, without a shareholder which will change every two years," he told the French Senate in a hearing on trade globalisation.
Gle des Eaux seeks world media =2
"The real battle is taking place on the international market," he said, adding that any group which could not master content, production and broadcasting would be a fragile one.
"Once you have a group with a French identity, you have the possibility of helping the expansion of the French identity," he said.

"What we want to do in the years to come...is to be able to promote a certain number of products of French culture such as a theme channel developed by Canal Plus, based on French lifestyle," Messier added.
"We will try to get the bulk of French industrialists round the table who could benefit from the promotion of this French lifestyle on the American or Asian markets," he added.
